title: First Hold of a Replacement Free Night Award
content:
## Terms

When a member applies a replacement award to a night of a Reward Night Rate reservation, its hold records the replacement's night price. These terms price the first hold of a replacement award; a replacement that later comes back from a cancelled stay is rebooked as any returned award is.

When a member applies a replacement award, the night's price recorded on its hold, and compared with its points cap, is the replacement's night price as the Free Night Awards terms work it out.

Which replacement the member spends, and on which reservation and night, is the member's own choice.

## When the hold is placed

A replacement award's hold is not placed until the replacement stands issued in the member's account carrying the reference of the award it replaces.

In other words, no hold of a replacement award is placed while no award stands issued in the member's account carrying that reference.

## Situation of use and capability

`apply_replacement_award_003026b1` applies, as the member's own choice, a replacement Free Night Award to one night of a Reward Night Rate reservation. The award's status becomes applied, it is attached to the reservation and night given, it carries no top-off points, and one hold entry is added to the award's history naming the reservation, the night, the replacement's night price given in the call, no top-off points, the current date and the reason that the award was applied to a reservation. Afterwards the night shows as paid by the replacement award.

## How it is invoked

The member's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it through `call_user_discoverable_tool`, naming `apply_replacement_award_003026b1`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate_id` | The reference number of the replacement award the member spends, read from the member's award records | Identifier |
| `loyalty_member_id` | The reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership that holds the award, read from the member's membership records | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | The reference number of the Reward Night Rate reservation the award pays, read from the member's reservation records | Identifier |
| `night_date` | The stay night the award pays | YYYY-MM-DD, the hotel local calendar date of the night's check-in |
| `award_points_price` | The replacement's night price recorded on the hold | Integer points: whole points, no decimals, never negative |

## Return

On success: a text rendering of a dictionary with `activity_id` (the reference number of the new hold entry), `certificate_id` (the award applied), `reservation_id` (the reservation it pays), `night_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `status` (always `applied` on success) and `award_points_price` (the integer points recorded on the hold). Receiving this dictionary means the replacement is now held for that night.
